assertions.claim: C with ADD,MUL,NEG,INV,ZERO,ONE satisfies the frozen commutative-field schema 182003.
DX with its frozen operations is a vector space over C under schema 182004.
DY with its frozen operations is a vector space over C under schema 182004.
ACT is a total single-valued relation X x Y -> C.
VARX is a total single-valued relation X x Y x DX -> C.
VARY is a total single-valued relation X x Y x DY -> C.
STATX(x,y) iff VARX(x,y,dx)=ZERO for every represented dx in DX.
STATY(x,y) iff VARY(x,y,dy)=ZERO for every represented dy in DY.

explicit_nonclaims.claim: The module does not derive VARX or VARY from ACT.
The module does not define limits, topology, differentiability, manifolds, functional analysis, connections, curvature, torsion, tetrads, or Einstein equations.
A source instance must independently justify that its declared VARX/VARY relations are first variations of its ACTION.
Qualification of this module would not by itself close any W occurrence; G7 source-local reconstruction is separately required.
